yukon blonde.bio: Vancouver indie-rock band Yukon Blonde makes harmony-rich guitar pop and rock that has expanded over time into synth-heavy, psychedelic and dance-oriented songwriting.

yves jarvis.bio: Montréal-based singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Yves Jarvis makes genre-bending experimental music that moves through indie rock, R&B, folk, soul and home-recorded abstraction.

zach zoya.bio: Rouyn-Noranda-born, Montréal-rooted singer, rapper and songwriter Zach Zoya blends melodic rap, alternative R&B and pop with a cross-cultural perspective shaped by South African and French-Canadian influences.

zeds dead.bio: Toronto electronic duo Zeds Dead, formed by Dylan Mamid and Zachary Rapp-Rovan, has built an international bass-music career around dubstep, drum and bass, house, hip-hop sampling and the Deadbeats label.

zeina.bio: Montréal-raised singer-songwriter Zeina blends contemporary R&B and pop with Arabic musical influence, writing and performing across English, French and Arabic.

zig mentality.bio: Toronto independent band ZIG MENTALITY makes immersive, self-produced rock built around a studio-focused approach and a tightly controlled DIY aesthetic.
